description: Level 1 baseline recorded before Level 2 increment 1 changes
workingTree: clean (src/missions.js 'modified' flag was a CRLF/LF stat artefact; its changes are committed in d2ea7d4)

environment.browser: Claude desktop built-in browser, Chromium 152, Windows 11
environment.note: Browser pane was hidden during the run, so absolute timings are pessimistic; compare only against runs taken the same way.

botRun.method: ?dev, __start(), then __botRun(1500) in slices until missions.ended; one auto-pause (blur) resumed by the harness
botRun.consoleWarnings: 277 WebGL 'framebuffer incomplete: zero size' warnings, caused by the canvas being 0x0 while the pane was hidden (not a game error)

restart: restart() after the end screen returned to state 'playing', stage 'p1', no errors

perf.method: __perf2(60): fixed-step update + full post-processed render with gl.finish(); renderer.info accumulated across passes
perf.existingPerfTool: __perf() reports calls:1 / tris:1 because the composer resets renderer.info on every pass; its msPerFrame was 49-54 ms in the hidden pane

knownPreExistingIssues: The bot does not survive an automatic pause (window blur / visibility change / pointer-lock loss): __step only advances while state is 'playing'
The real animation loop also calls update() while the bot steps, so bot runs are not deterministic
Phase 2 HUD shows the bomber escape countdown from 22 s although the escape window is now 30 s (missions.js hudInfo)
